governing_invariants: Implementation correctness does not imply authorization.
Approval does not imply execution permission.
Resolver RESOLVED does not imply Authority, Human Approval, Bind authorization, admissibility, or execution permission.
Uncertainty, contradiction, mutation, delay, or provenance loss may weaken a conclusion but must never strengthen it.
No activation-review artifact may self-authorize activation.
Activation evidence must be independently challengeable and auditable by a reviewer separate from the implementation author and activation requester.

activation_target_boundary.description: If later approved, activation may only make the existing separate_store_readonly_v1 resolver callable from one explicitly named evidence-only consumer. It does not authorize any effect-bearing path.
activation_target_boundary.note: The exact caller/consumer is intentionally not named yet; therefore activation is not currently justifiable.

gates.name: EXACT_IMPLEMENTATION_IDENTITY
current_evidence: validated PR head 0fe3e953... had 23/23 observed workflows success
merge f3db837d... is file-identical to validated PR head
resolver runtime Git blob identity is frozen at 64431fecf69579d8554cbc590a67ce8ca9d4a612
focused behavior-test Git blob identity is frozen at a247bf768ca7a0ac6f65ac13fbb2e07664336b30
current implementation-manifest Git blob identity is frozen at 5174dab99f9284498966a4bd8968db5ec910b052
dedicated AER-01 exact-SHA workflow and proof checker are defined
missing_evidence: successful dedicated AER-01 workflow on the exact merged-main SHA of this proof-enablement change
retained AER-01 artifact bound to that exact SHA
independent closure record pinning the exact main SHA, workflow run, job, artifact ID and artifact content/hash
gates.closure_condition: A successful dedicated exact-main AER-01 run proves the frozen resolver/test/manifest Git blob identities on the exact merged-main SHA, retains the bound artifact, and a later independent closure record pins and verifies that evidence.

gates.name: RUNTIME_REACHABILITY_INVENTORY
current_evidence: repository search found the resolver callable only in its implementation module and focused tests
missing_evidence: source-level isolation must be frozen by executable regression test
future activation wiring must be added to a declared runtime reachability inventory
gates.closure_condition: Executable source-level proof shows no undeclared production caller/import path; any later caller is explicitly declared and reviewed.

gates.name: NAMED_ACTIVATION_TARGET_AND_CALLER
missing_evidence: exact production or controlled runtime caller module
caller identity / caller_id_hash provenance
exact namespace scope
exact activation configuration
gates.closure_condition: One exact evidence-only activation target and caller are named, scope-pinned, reviewable, and default-disabled.

gates.name: SNAPSHOT_PROVENANCE_AND_ADMISSIBILITY
current_evidence: resolver proves exact membership in caller-supplied immutable snapshot only
missing_evidence: who or what creates the activation-time snapshot
why that snapshot is admissible for the intended consumer
provenance continuity from source to immutable snapshot
freshness policy if freshness is required by the consumer
gates.closure_condition: Activation-time snapshot provenance/admissibility is independently defined and verified without making RESOLVED itself an admissibility claim.

gates.name: CONSUMER_NON_AMPLIFICATION
current_evidence: resolver hard-false semantic guarantees prevent self-issued authority
missing_evidence: downstream consumer does not translate RESOLVED directly into ALLOW, Authority, Human Approval, Bind authorization, or execution permission
consumer preserves the forbidden-inference boundary
gates.closure_condition: Executable consumer tests prove resolver output remains evidence-only and cannot directly or indirectly create stronger authority.

gates.name: FAILURE_AND_UNCERTAINTY_PROPAGATION
current_evidence: resolver itself fails closed to UNRESOLVED for malformed, unauthorized, absent, or schema-invalid evidence
missing_evidence: activation-time consumer propagates UNRESOLVED/failure without fallback or authority amplification
missing or degraded provenance cannot be repaired into an admissible success
gates.closure_condition: End-to-end evidence-only consumer tests show all degraded resolver outcomes preserve or reduce conclusion strength.

gates.name: EXPLICIT_AUTHORIZATION_AND_APPROVAL
missing_evidence: explicit authorization for the exact activation target
explicit human approval for the exact bounded activation configuration
gates.closure_condition: A separate explicit authorization/approval record names the exact target, profile, scope, implementation identity, and non-effect-bearing boundary.

gates.name: EFFECT_PATH_SEPARATION
current_evidence: current implementation is unwired from /v1/decide, Bind, execution permission, and effect-bearing paths
missing_evidence: future activation wiring must preserve that separation
negative proof must show no resolver result can bypass downstream authorization/admissibility boundaries
gates.closure_condition: Exact activation wiring has executable negative proof that no direct or indirect effect-bearing path is created.

gates.name: DEFAULT_DISABLED_DEACTIVATION_AND_ROLLBACK
missing_evidence: default-disabled activation mechanism
bounded disable/deactivation control
rollback semantics that do not create new authority
material-change rule reopening review
gates.closure_condition: Activation can be explicitly enabled/disabled for the named target, with fail-closed rollback and no hidden fallback.

gates.name: POST_ACTIVATION_EVIDENCE
missing_evidence: exact activated code/config identity
runtime evidence that intended caller is the only declared caller
runtime proof semantic guarantees remain hard-false
evidence of disabled effect-path connection
gates.closure_condition: After any separately approved activation, a bounded post-activation proof confirms the exact runtime identity and preserved boundaries before activation is treated as closed.

gates.name: INDEPENDENT_CHALLENGE_AND_AUDITABILITY
current_evidence: external design review identified independent challenge/auditability as a separate activation-evidence dimension
missing_evidence: exact independent reviewer identity and role
reviewer separation from implementation author and activation requester
conflict-of-interest / independence disclosure
frozen manifest of exact artifacts the reviewer must inspect
review procedure that permits challenge, refusal, and unresolved findings rather than approval-only flow
structured reviewer decision with APPROVE / REFUSE / ABSTAIN semantics
review timestamp and exact implementation/config/gate identities reviewed
durable preservation of reviewer decision and reviewed-artifact manifest
read-only reconstruction / verification path for the preserved review record
rule that missing, stale, contradictory, or unverifiable independent-review evidence keeps activation blocked

reviewer_separation.note: AER-11 does not replace AER-07. Role separation must be explicit and reviewable.

minimum_review_artifacts: exact implementation identity and code/test artifact identities
exact proposed activation target, caller, profile, namespace and configuration
all open findings, limitations and non-claims
gates.closure_condition: An identified independent reviewer, separate from the implementation author and activation requester, inspects the frozen activation evidence package, records an independently verifiable APPROVE decision with no unresolved blocking findings, and the decision plus artifact manifest are durably preserved and reconstructable.

closure_rule.activation_review_can_close_only_when: AER-01 through AER-09 and AER-11 are CLOSED/PASS and a separate explicit authorization/approval record exists.
closure_rule.post_activation_closure_requires: AER-10 evidence after the separately approved activation.

completeness_review.note: External design-review feedback accepted the ten-gate foundation and requested one additional independent challenge/auditability dimension before gate-by-gate closure.
